requirement.prompt: A folded paper boat continuously changes into a timber sailing yacht as a pool becomes ocean. This is an authored 3D raw take, not photoreal recorded footage.

criteria: One folded paper boat changes into one timber sailing vessel without a cut or a separate vessel fading in.
The whole mast and sail remain inside the frame throughout the take.
Water changes from a pool into visible ocean waves.
The ending clearly reads as a timber yacht with canvas sails and rigging.
